name: Giant Size X-Men #1
description_md:
This deck is themed after the 1975 comic book in the title. It centers around X-Men allies, obviously, using the characters featured in the comic. A lot of first appearances here, as Cyclops assembles a new team to rescue the original X-Men. Beast is not included as he is mentioned to have "graduated" and is no longer a member of the team. There's also no Thunderbird, as he hasn't been printed. Jean Grey is Marvel Girl in the comic, Phoenix in this deck. 

Given the number of allies, the deck works fairly well for the theme.
